demonstrated_actions.observed: deck.stable_id=null, autoplay_enabled=true, no feed primed by this script yet. Note: the route's own installTrackifyFeed() independently attempted a real default feed load at mount and it also hit the same real HTTP 500 (visible as the 'Trackify: could not load the feed' toast in 01-cold-empty-state.png) -- the schema gap affects the app's own default cold-load path, not just this script's later forced chain.

feed_epoch bumped 0->1, feed_scope=all_tracks, deck still empty. Autoplay was disabled only for this priming step to stop installTrackifyAutoplay's own 250ms tick from independently picking a first candidate and racing the explicit e2e_force_load call below (confirmed by reproducing the race live: an earlier capture run without this step visited some track ids twice before landing). Re-enabled immediately after the forced chain settles.

real engine returned HTTP 500 (sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: c.ImagePath in apps/webui/server/rb_vendor_pkg/track_rows.py bulk_rb_meta) for t-fixture-0001 through t-fixture-0004 in order; Trackify's quarantine logic caught each one and chained to the next candidate without ever blocking on a modal; landed on t-fixture-0005 (the one primed track with no vendor mapping), which loaded and began playing. Elapsed 2208ms across the whole chain.

demonstrated_actions.observed: last_skip_reason='manual skip exhausted feed', deck unchanged, no error raised -- confirms the exhausted-feed path degrades gracefully under a second, manual trigger too.

known_pre_existing_gap_not_caused_by_thi: The HTTP 500s that drive the skip chain trace to apps/webui/server/rb_vendor_pkg/track_rows.py's bulk_rb_meta querying c.ImagePath, a column scripts/redteam_fixture_library.py's synthetic master.plain.db does not create. This is the same pre-existing fixture-schema gap the prior (now-stale) FEATURE EVIDENCE comment on this PR already identified and flagged as a non-blocking follow-up; it reproduced identically in this capture. None of the 4 fixes since the prior capture touch either file.
anomaly_observed: One 'Failed to load resource: 404 (Not Found)' console line appeared after the last 500, reproduced identically across all 3 capture runs in this session. It was not traceable to any Trackify/engine API path in the engine's own log for this run (the engine log shows no 404s at all, and no engine access-log lines at all in this build); the most likely explanation is a benign browser-default request (e.g. favicon.ico -- this run's 1280x800 viewport and dev server otherwise serves everything the page references) rather than a Trackify-path failure, but this was not independently confirmed with a network-request trace, so it is reported here rather than silently dropped or guessed at with false confidence.
autoplay_race_found_and_worked_around: A capture run in this session that primed the feed and called e2e_force_load without first disabling autoplay showed the retry chain revisit t-fixture-0001/0002/0003 a second time (7 failures observed instead of 4) before landing on t-fixture-0005 -- installTrackifyAutoplay's own 250ms tick independently picks and loads the first feed candidate as soon as the feed is non-empty and the deck is null, racing this script's own explicit e2e_force_load call. This is not a defect in the 4 fixes under evidence here (autoplay's deck-null first-pick branch and e2e_force_load's own retry chain are both pre-existing PERFMODE-15 mechanics, not touched by this recapture's 4 commits); it is a property of driving e2e_force_load with autoplay left on, matching why tests/e2e/trackify-mode.spec.ts calls `ipc.toggle_autoplay(false)` before priming. This capture does the same and the final run landed cleanly with exactly 4 failures.
